title: Sensei Governed Runner Composition Candidate Artifact V1
description: The O3 immutable, content-addressed sealing of one generation attempt's candidate tree. Binds repository/base/workspace identity, session/plan/generation/attempt identity, three distinct digests (input snapshot, proposed change, final candidate content), and the final tree's own canonical manifest -- preserving actual candidate bytes, not merely their hashes.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/runnercomposition. Written and read only through a CandidateArtifactStore with verified Put/Get (docs/design/governed-runner-composition-o3.md hard law 14) -- O4/O5/retry/resume address a candidate by candidate_artifact_digest_sha256 against that store, never a temporary directory.

input_candidate_digest_sha256.$comment: Computed by ManifestDigest over the pinned input snapshot's manifest, before any provider runs (hard law 10).

proposed_change_digest_sha256.$comment: The git-diff-shaped digest from the input snapshot to the final candidate tree -- a distinct identity from either tree's own manifest digest (hard law 10).

final_candidate_content_digest_sha256.$comment: Computed by ManifestDigest over the final candidate tree's own manifest -- the same scheme as input_candidate_digest_sha256, applied to the ending state (hard law 10).

manifest.$comment: The final candidate tree's canonical, sorted entry list. final_candidate_content_digest_sha256 is ManifestDigest(manifest).

candidate_artifact_digest_sha256.$comment: Self-referential semantic digest of this document with this field zeroed before hashing.

path.$comment: POSIX-relative, '/'-separated, no leading '/', no '.'/'..' segment, no embedded NUL or newline byte.

content.$comment: Raw file bytes, base64-encoded by Go's JSON encoding. Meaningful only for mode regular/executable; empty for mode symlink. Never nil at the Go level, so this is always a string, never null.

symlink_target.$comment: Literal, unresolved symlink target -- never resolved or followed. Meaningful only for mode symlink; empty for mode regular/executable.

content_digest_sha256.$comment: sha256 of content (mode regular/executable) or of symlink_target's raw bytes (mode symlink).
